primary.title: Kuku Technologies gets SEBI nod for IPO launch: Top things to know about the issue
primary.summary: SEBI has approved Kuku Technologies' IPO plans, following the company’s confidential draft IPO filing in June. The IPO aims to raise ₹2,500 crore to ₹3,500 crore and will use proceeds for technology and geographic expansion.
